text:
Ana: Quick sync — doing a venue run-through for demo night at The Foundry next Wed. Need final booth layout, speaker confirmations, swag pick plan, and inbound lead routing by EOD Friday.

Lucas: Got it. I walked the space today. We can squeeze a 10x10 table + demo table against the east wall. Will share photos. :thumbsup:

Jen: Photos please — I need exact dims to finalize banner artwork and stage backdrop. Also confirm power outlets on east wall?

Lucas: Two outlets there, one on the pillar. I can bring a 20ft extension and a power strip as backup.

Miriam: Speaker confirmations: 3 accepted, 1 tentative. Can Sam confirm the customer panel? We need headshots + 1-sentence bios for the event page and for the on-site teleprompter.

Sam: Confirmed — customer panelists are in. I'll collect headshots & bios by Thu. Also, what's the lead flow? Who owns inbound QR scan -> meeting booking?

Ana: Routing plan: QR -> universal demo form -> webhook -> Segment -> route based on region tag. For APAC -> sales@apac, for NA -> SDR queue (sdrcollab). If 'high interest' checkbox checked, route to Sam directly. We should test rules.

Ryan: I can run a dry test Thu morning. Provide a sample payload for the webhook. Also we should make a fallback rule: if routing fails, email to ops@redwood-inference.com.

Ana: Payload example for testing: ```{ "email":"test+event@acme.com","region":"NA","interest_level":"high","lead_source":"demo_night_qr" }```

DeployBot: Reminder: event form is using /forms/prod endpoint. Any schema changes require 24h to propagate.

Jen: Swag layout: table 1 = stickers + one-pager + business cards; table 2 = tees + hoodies (hanger rack behind). Need pricing label removed from sample tees.

Swagbot: Inventory snapshot (real-time): stickers: 210, tees: 95 (M/L split accounted), hoodies: 38, tote bags: 120. Pending ordered: 60 hoodies ETA Tue.

Miriam: Webinar tie-in: capture emails on-site and auto-enroll to the post-event webinar drip. Draft copy for the follow-up invite ready? I have a short headline + CTA we can A/B test: "See how we cut inference costs by 3x — live demo" vs "Ship LLM features faster with predictable latency — demo"

Sam: Use the first headline for customers who attended a demo; use the second for booth signups from Enterprise domains. We'll need domain heuristics in Segment.

Ana: Bench narratives for the booth: 1) Latency SLOs for multimodal demo (p95 < 220ms) 2) Cost comparison: batch+quantization vs baseline (show token $/k). Keep slides to 2 visual charts and one short blurb. Miriam, can you prepare the quick two-slide benchmark summary?

Miriam: On it. Will produce one slide with a small table and one with a single line chart. Share by Fri morning.

Lucas: Logistics: who's picking up swag from vendor on Tue? And who will check in speakers on site?

Jen: I can do vendor pickup Tue afternoon. Lucas you ok with speaker check-in?

Lucas: Yep, I'll handle check-in and AV handoff.

Ryan: I'll bring an extra 5' HDMI cable, dongles, and a mini UPS. Also running network scan of venue Friday so form submissions don't get blocked by firewall.

Ana: Last call for blockers — if no issues, we'll freeze creative by EOD Thu and run the routing smoke test Fri 9am PT. Everyone please ack. :eyes:

Sam: Ack.

Jen: Ack.

Lucas: Ack.

Miriam: Ack.

Ryan: Ack.

Swagbot: Order pending confirmation: 60 hoodies — ETA Tue.

Ana: Thanks team — I’ll circle back with the final checklist and the QR image for printing.
